name: Zero Lag EMA
description: This keyword returns the Zero Lag EMA of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the Zero Lag EMA of any period of any series of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword

![Example](./images/img-1632224820.png)

You can plot the  Zero Lag EMA   on any series, like close in the above example, you can also plot EMA of RSI, OPEN etc

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description: Nested series keyword to operate on, e.g. CLOSE(...), OPEN(...), HIGH(...).
